---
title: "MINDSET2 Baseline"
subtitle: "IPCC regions; up to 2050; results: `r params$results_dir`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B, %Y %H:%M')`"
output:
  beamer_presentation:
    theme: "Antibes"
    colortheme: "dolphin"
    fig_width: 8
    fig_height: 4.5
    fig_caption: true
header-includes:
  - \usepackage[sfdefault,condensed]{roboto}
  - \usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
  - \AtBeginSection{}
  - \AtBeginSubsection{}
# Usage: set results_dir below (relative to Results/) and press Knit; baseline_figures_IEA_CP.pdf is written into that folder.
# Console: rmarkdown::render("baseline_figures.Rmd", params = list(results_dir = "archive_baseline_IEA_CP_YYYYMMDD_HHMM"),
#            output_dir = "archive_baseline_IEA_CP_YYYYMMDD_HHMM", output_file = "baseline_figures_IEA_CP.pdf")
params:
  results_dir: "archive_calibration_IEA_CP_20261119_2337"   # change here! Or "." for Results folder
knit: (function(input, ...) {
    p <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(input)$params;
    rmarkdown::render(input, output_dir = file.path(dirname(input), p$results_dir),
      output_file = "baseline_figures.pdf", envir = globalenv()) })
---



```{r Load packages,include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(arrow)
library(knitr)
library(ggthemes)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(kableExtra)
library(plotly)

sysfonts::font_add_google(name = "Roboto Condensed")
showtext::showtext_auto()

# Fuel sectors identified by name (sheet P), so the energy figures work for GLORIA-120 and any aggregation.
# GLORIA-120: Coal 24, 25, 62; Petrol 26, 63; Gas 27, 94; Electricity 93; primary fuels 24-27.
sector_names <- readxl::read_excel(file.path("..", "Data", "MSET_data", "Variable_list_MINDSET.xlsx"), sheet = "P")
fuel_lookup <- sector_names %>%
  transmute(code = Lfd_Nr,
            fuel = case_when(
              str_detect(Sector_names, regex("hard coal|lignite|coke oven", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Coal",
              str_detect(Sector_names, regex("petroleum extraction|refined petroleum", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Petrol",
              str_detect(Sector_names, regex("gas extraction|gaseous fuels", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Gas",
              str_detect(Sector_names, regex("electric power", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Electricity"),
            primary = str_detect(Sector_names, regex("hard coal|lignite|petroleum extraction|gas extraction", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fuel))
fuel_of <- setNames(fuel_lookup$fuel, fuel_lookup$code)
primary_fuel_sectors <- fuel_lookup$code[fuel_lookup$primary]

# Results to plot (folder relative to Results/; set in params at the top)
baseline_name <- "IEA_CP"
scen_of <- function(f) {   # scenario of a results file: numbered summary file or per-year energy flows
  b <- basename(f)
  s <- ifelse(grepl("_energy_flows(_fd)?_\\d{4}\\.parquet$", b),
              sub("^results_file_long_(.+)_energy_flows(_fd)?_\\d{4}\\.parquet$", "\\1", b),
              sub("^results_file_long_(.+)_\\d+\\.(csv|parquet)$", "\\1", b))
  ifelse(s == b, NA_character_, s)
}
rfiles <- function(pattern) {   # baseline result files in params$results_dir
  f <- list.files(params$results_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  f[scen_of(f) %in% baseline_name]
}

# Two header rows for a table pivoted with names_from = c(<a>, <b>) (columns "<a>_<b>"), built from the table's own
# columns so tables work for any run length (e.g. model_end = 2030) and any sector aggregation.
# Drop header groups with no columns (e.g. no 2025+ values in a short or broken run), which LaTeX cannot typeset.
header_groups <- function(h) h[h > 0]
pivot_header <- function(k, tab, n_id = 1, id_labels = rep(" ", n_id)) {
  cols  <- names(tab)[-seq_len(n_id)]
  yr    <- sub("_.*$", "", cols)
  other <- sub("_$", "", sub("^[^_]*_", "", cols))
  if (all(rle(yr)$lengths == 1)) { lower <- yr; up <- rle(other) } else { lower <- other; up <- rle(yr) }
  k %>%
    add_header_above(c(setNames(rep(1, n_id), id_labels), setNames(rep(1, length(lower)), lower))) %>%
    add_header_above(c(setNames(n_id, " "), setNames(up$lengths, up$values)))
}
```

```{r Load data#2 - 2D vars,include=FALSE}
#   res <- read_parquet(filename, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
#     mutate(scenario=str_extract(basename(filename), "(?<=results\\_file\\_long\\_)[a-z_]{1,}")) %>% 
#     filter(!is.na(fuel_use)) %>% filter(year > 2025 & REG_imp == 'SAS') %>% filter(fuel_use > 0)
#   return(res)
# }

read_and_prefix <- function(filename) {
  res <- read_csv(filename, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(scenario=str_extract(basename(filename), "(?<=results\\_file\\_long\\_)[A-Za-z_]{1,}"))
  return(res)
}

combined_data <- files %>%
  map(read_and_prefix) %>%
  list_rbind()

combined_data <- gather(combined_data, "var_name", "value", -REG_imp,-PROD_COMM,-year,-scenario)

unique(combined_data$scenario)
unique(combined_data$var_name)
unique(combined_data$REG_imp)

```


## 1.1 Economic output
### Economic output - all regions, figure
\framesubtitle{bn USD, constant 2019 price}

```{r Print 1.1a figure,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
df <- combined_data %>% 
  filter(var_name == 'output' & year > 2018 & scenario == 'IEA_CP_') %>%
  group_by(REG_imp, year) %>% 
  summarise(value = sum(value)) %>%
  mutate(value = value / 10**6)

set_colors <- brewer.pal(n = length(unique(df$REG_imp)), name = "Paired")
names(set_colors) <- unique(df$REG_imp)

g <- df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=value, color=REG_imp)) + 
  geom_line()  + 
  theme_few() + 
  labs(y='economic output (bn USD constant price)', color='region') + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) + 
  scale_color_manual(values=set_colors) + 
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Roboto Condensed"))

g

# ggplotly(g)
```


### Economic output - all regions, table
\framesubtitle{bn USD, constant 2019 price}

```{r Print 1.1a table,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
df <- combined_data %>% 
  filter(var_name == 'output' & year > 2018 & scenario == 'IEA_CP_') %>%
  group_by(REG_imp, year) %>% 
  summarise(value = sum(value)) %>%
  mutate(value = value / 10**6)

df1 <- df %>%
  mutate(value = round(value, digits=0)) %>%
  mutate(value = scales::comma(value)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols='REG_imp', names_from='year', values_from='value') %>%
  select(REG_imp, any_of(c('2019', '2025', '2030', '2040', '2050')))

df2 <- df %>% group_by(REG_imp) %>%
  mutate(value_g = value/dplyr::lag(value) - 1) %>%
  mutate(value_g = value_g * 100) %>%
  mutate(period = ifelse(year < 2031, "2019-2030", paste0("2031-", max(df$year)))) %>%
  group_by(REG_imp, period) %>%
  summarise(value_g_avg = mean(value_g, na.rm=T)) %>% 
  mutate(value_g_avg = round(value_g_avg, digits=2)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols='REG_imp', names_from='period', values_from='value_g_avg')

df1 %>% left_join(df2) %>%
  rename(Region = REG_imp) %>%
  kbl(booktabs=TRUE) %>%
      # digits = 0, format.args = list(big.mark = ",")) %>%
  add_header_above(header_groups(c(" " = 1, "Absolute value" = ncol(df1) - 1, "Average growth %" = ncol(df2) - 1))) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "scale_down","HOLD_position"))
```

## 1.4 Prices
### Output deflator (output-weighted), figure
\framesubtitle{index, 2019 = 100}

```{r Print 1.4a figure,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}

g <- combined_data %>% 
  filter(var_name %in% c('dp_all','output') & year > 2018 & scenario == 'IEA_CP_') %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c('REG_imp','PROD_COMM','year'), names_from='var_name', values_from='value') %>%
  group_by(REG_imp, year) %>% 
  mutate(dp_all = dp_all * output / sum(output)) %>%
  summarise(dp_all = sum(dp_all)) %>% 
  mutate(dp_all = dp_all+1) %>%
  mutate(dp_all = cumprod(dp_all) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=dp_all, color=REG_imp)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  theme_few() + 
  labs(y='Price-index, 2019 = 100', color='region') + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) + 
  scale_color_manual(values=set_colors)

g
# ggplotly(g)
```

```{r Print 1.4b table,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
df <- combined_data %>%
```

# 4D - Energy variables

```{r Load data#1 - 4D vars,include=FALSE}
# parquet — load all scenarios
files = rfiles("results_file_long.*energy_flows_[0-9]{4}.parquet")
head(open_dataset(files[1]),5)
files
```


```{r Load data#2 - 4D vars,include=FALSE}
read_and_prefix <- function(filename) {
  res <- read_parquet(filename, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(scenario=str_extract(basename(filename), "(?<=_long_).+(?=_energy_flows_\\d{4})")) %>%
    mutate(year = as.numeric(str_extract(basename(filename), "[0-9]{4}"))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(fuel_use)) %>% filter(year > 2018) %>% filter(fuel_use > 0)
  return(res)
}

combined_data <- files %>%
  map(read_and_prefix) %>%
  list_rbind()

combined_data <- gather(combined_data, "var_name", "value", -REG_imp,-REG_exp,-PROD_COMM,-TRAD_COMM,-year,-scenario)

unique(combined_data$scenario)
unique(combined_data$var_name)
unique(combined_data$REG_imp)
unique(combined_data$year)

```

```{r Print 2.1a1 table,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
  summarise(value_g_avg = mean(value_g, na.rm=T)) %>% 
  mutate(value_g_avg = round(value_g_avg, digits=2)) %>%
```
```{r Print 2.2a1 table,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
  pivot_wider(id_cols='REG_exp', names_from='period', values_from='value_g_avg')

df1 %>% left_join(df2) %>%
  rename(Region = REG_exp) %>%
  kbl(booktabs=TRUE) %>%
      # digits = 0, format.args = list(big.mark = ",")) %>%
  add_header_above(header_groups(c(" " = 1, "Absolute value (EJ)" = ncol(df1) - 1, "Average growth %" = ncol(df2) - 1))) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "scale_down","HOLD_position"))
```

## 2.4 Household energy consumption
```{r Load data - household fuels,include=FALSE}
# physical: household (FD_1) fuel use by flow, TJ (energy_flows_fd files)
fd_files <- rfiles("results_file_long.*energy_flows_fd_[0-9]{4}.parquet")
hh_phys <- fd_files %>%
  map(function(f) read_parquet(f) %>%
        mutate(year = as.numeric(str_extract(basename(f), "[0-9]{4}")))) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  filter(FD == "FD_1", year > 2018) %>%
  mutate(fuel = unname(fuel_of[as.character(TRAD_COMM)])) %>%
  filter(fuel %in% c("Petrol", "Electricity")) %>%
  group_by(year, REG_imp, fuel) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(fuel_use) / 10**6, .groups = "drop") %>%   # TJ -> EJ
  mutate(unit = "Physical (EJ)")

# monetary: household final consumption by product, kUSD (summary file _1.parquet)
hh_files <- rfiles("results_file_long.*_1\\.parquet")
hh_mon <- hh_files %>%
  map(function(f) read_parquet(f, col_select = c("REG_imp", "TRAD_COMM", "year", "household_consumption"))) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  filter(year > 2018) %>%
  mutate(fuel = unname(fuel_of[as.character(TRAD_COMM)])) %>%
  filter(fuel %in% c("Petrol", "Electricity")) %>%
  group_by(year, REG_imp, fuel) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(household_consumption) / 10**6, .groups = "drop") %>%   # kUSD -> bn USD
  mutate(unit = "Monetary (bn USD)")
```

### Household electricity and petrol consumption, figure
\framesubtitle{physical (EJ) and monetary (bn USD) household consumption by region}

```{r Print 2.4a figure,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
g <- bind_rows(hh_phys, hh_mon) %>%
  mutate(unit = factor(unit, levels = c("Physical (EJ)", "Monetary (bn USD)"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=value, color=REG_imp)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(unit ~ fuel, scales="free_y") +
  theme_few() +
  labs(y='household consumption', color='region') +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
  scale_color_manual(values=set_colors)

g
```

### Unemployment & shadow unemployment rate, table
\framesubtitle{rate, employment divided by labour force}

```{r Print 3.1b table,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
df <- combined_data %>% 
  filter(year > 2018 & scenario == 'IEA_CP_' & var_name %in% c('unemployment_rate','shadow_unemployment_rate')) %>% 
  select(-scenario) %>%
  mutate(value = value) %>% 
  # mutate(value = round(value, digits=0)) %>%
  mutate(value = scales::percent(value, accuracy=.1)) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2019,2025,2030,2040,2050)) %>%
  mutate(var_name = recode(var_name, unemployment_rate = "Unemployment rate", shadow_unemployment_rate = "Shadow unemployment rate")) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols='REG_imp', names_from=c('year','var_name'), values_from='value') 

df %>%
  rename(Region = REG_imp) %>%
  # rename_at(vars(matches("^[0-9]{4}")), ~ str_extract(., "^[0-9]{4}"))
  kbl(booktabs=TRUE, col.names = NULL) %>%
      # digits = 0, format.args = list(big.mark = ",")) %>%
  pivot_header(df) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "scale_down","HOLD_position"))
```
